record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. The Ministry of Information reports a locally developed offline AI application, without designating a national evaluation body.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The retrieved Ministry of Information interview discusses a developer's offline AI app and local safeguards. It does not establish national AI governance arrangements or a government-designated evaluation body, so primary national governance coverage remains insufficient. check.language_note: The recorded ti query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Indexed results were sparse or noisy; the recorded language search does not establish complete coverage. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. English queries are not relied on for the national-language requirement in this check; the recorded Tigrinya query supplies that leg. The English flag is a coverage decision, not a new adjudication of working-language status.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.

record.notes: The re-check read the Ministry of Information Eri-Chat interview (er-shabait-erichat-2025) and the current press-release index at https://shabait.com/category/press-release/. The interview describes a ministry-employed software developer and an offline application, including privacy and content restrictions, but no national institute designation or mandate to test advanced models. Native-language searches yielded no usable official AI-institute result; this is limited indexed-web coverage, not proof of absence. A UN Technology Bank visit page returned HTTP 403. Older secondary profile retained as provenance, superseded by the individual searches and primary page.
